explanation: Bowie unveiled the flame-haired, otherworldly rock star on a 1972 album, then retired him on stage at a London concert in July 1973.

claims.text: David Bowie created the stage persona Ziggy Stardust.
Marc Bolan, Freddie Mercury and Elton John did not create Ziggy Stardust.
Bowie's album The Rise and Fall of Ziggy Stardust and the Spiders from Mars was released in 1972.
Ziggy Stardust was presented as a red-haired, otherworldly rock star.
Bowie announced the end of Ziggy Stardust from the stage of the Hammersmith Odeon, London, on 3 July 1973.
